data.summary:
Senior Functional Business Analyst with 12+ years of experience delivering business and regulatory transformation initiatives across Investment Banking, Capital Markets, Asset Management, and Financial Services. Experienced in collaborating with business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, prepare functional documentation, and support end-to-end solution delivery across Agile and Waterfall environments.
Strong functional expertise in Equities, Fixed Income, FX, Derivatives, Corporate Actions, Reference Data, Fund Accounting, NAV, Trade Lifecycle, Data Governance, and Regulatory Reporting. Proven ability to bridge business and technology teams by translating business needs into functional requirements, supporting solution design, coordinating UAT, and driving successful implementation of enterprise-wide transformation initiatives.
Experienced working with global stakeholders across EMEA, APAC, and North America, supporting strategic change initiatives through business analysis, process improvement, data governance, and functional testing.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Business Analyst (Senior Manager)
Standard Chartered Bank (via Persolkelly) | Bengaluru
Mar 2024 – Present
Project
Master Data Governance & Finance Reference Data Transformation
Key Responsibilities
Conduct requirement gathering sessions with business and technology stakeholders. • Prepare Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), business process documentation, and functional requirements.
Perform impact analysis for change requests and enhancement initiatives. • Collaborate with Technology teams on solution design and functional validation. • Support Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release planning.
Coordinate SIT and UAT activities, defect tracking, and business sign-offs. • Manage reference data governance and data quality initiatives. • Work extensively with SAP, JIRA, Azure DevOps, and Confluence. • Support production releases and post-implementation validation.
Senior Business Analyst
Tech Mahindra | Bengaluru
Sep 2020 – Aug 2021
Client: Investment Data Services
Key Responsibilities
Gathered and analyzed business requirements for investment data platforms. • Prepared functional documentation and business workflows. • Worked closely with business users and German stakeholders to deliver benchmark management enhancements.
Executed SQL-based data validation and reconciliation. • Supported UAT execution and issue resolution. • Coordinated implementation activities with development teams.
Senior Business Analyst
IRIS Software
Nov 2021 – Aug 2022
Supported Business Analysis initiatives within Capital Markets. • Participated in requirement analysis and Agile delivery. • Prepared functional documentation. • Enhanced Business Analysis capabilities through Agile, SQL, and BA certifications.
Team Lead / Senior Analyst
Cognizant Technology Solutions (Client: NASDAQ)
Mar 2016 – Nov 2017
Key Responsibilities
Supported business transformation initiatives for global market data products. • Performed requirement analysis for data migration and onboarding projects. • Coordinated with global business stakeholders during process transitions. • Prepared SOPs, process documentation, and project reports. • Supported implementation of new data products and process improvements. • Managed stakeholder communication and issue resolution.
Investment Analyst
State Street Global Advisors
Apr 2010 – Sep 2014
Key Responsibilities
Supported investment management platforms covering Equities, Fixed Income,
Derivatives, and Alternative Investments.
Performed requirement gathering and functional analysis for data management
initiatives.
Supported Fund Accounting, NAV calculations, and Securities Reference Data. • Participated in UAT and business process improvement initiatives. • Worked with portfolio managers and global stakeholders on investment data quality.
Investment Research Analyst
Thomson Reuters
Sep 2007 – Mar 2010
Key Responsibilities
Supported Capital Markets and Investment Banking clients across EMEA and APAC. • Managed market data validation for Equities, Funds, ETFs, Fixed Income, and Derivatives. • Worked on regulatory initiatives including MiFID, EMIR, and Dodd-Frank. • Collaborated with exchanges, vendors, and global stakeholders to resolve data discrepancies.
Supported functional enhancements and process improvement initiatives.
